summary: The note describes the Palazzo Corner Spinelli, a palace in Venice, northern Italy. It sits on the Grand Canal in the sestiere of San Marco and stands directly across the canal from the Palazzo Querini Dubois. The note is brief and gives only location details.
one_line: Palazzo Corner Spinelli is a Venetian palace on the Grand Canal in San Marco, facing the Palazzo Querini Dubois.
key_facts: The Palazzo Corner Spinelli is a palace in Venice, northern Italy.
The Palazzo Corner Spinelli is located on the Grand Canal.
The Palazzo Corner Spinelli is in the sestiere of San Marco.
The Palazzo Corner Spinelli stands across the canal from the Palazzo Querini Dubois.
